# Error codes

:material-circle:{ .level-advanced } Advanced

Every diagnostic and warning code rusEFI can report, from the firmware's own list. Codes below 6000 follow the standard OBD-II P-code numbering (shown as `P0107` and so on); codes from 6000 up are rusEFI's own. TunerStudio shows active codes in the *Warning* indicator and the warning-code channels; the rusEFI console lists them too.

<!-- src: firmware/controllers/algo/obd_error_codes.h (enum class ObdCode and the P-code comments) -->

## Standard (OBD-II) codes

84 codes. *rusEFI condition* is what the firmware reports the code for, read from its name in the source; the *standard description* is the generic OBD-II meaning of that number, where the firmware lists it. The two can differ in detail.
